messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing post-launch blog + webinar funnel. Need a clear plan for CTA destinations, keyword targets, schema markup, and redirects. Who can take ownership of the SERP landing->webinar/lead page routing?

jonah: I can own canonical + keyword mapping. High level: 1) primary landing per intent 2) canonical tags + redirect fallbacks 3) schema (Event + FAQ) for webinar. Will post a mapping by EOD. @priya can you confirm final CTAs/anchor text? :thumbsup:

priya: Yep — final CTAs are: "Register for webinar", "Read benchmark" and "Get the starter kit". We'll surface 2 CTAs above the fold and tertiary CTAs in-post. Prefer short anchors: "Register" / "Benchmark" / "Starter kit". I can update copy for canonical URLs.

samir: On analytics: add distinct UTM_content values for each CTA (webinar_cta, bench_cta, kit_cta). Also request to instrument click-to-register funnel with event names: `cta_click`, `form_submit`, `thankyou_view`. Will add to the tracking ticket.

jonah: Draft redirect rules I'll propose (simple nginx-style):
```
# redirect legacy campaign pages to new landing
rewrite ^/launch-old-blog(.*)$ /launch-2026$1 permanent;
# fallback: if /register isn't available, route to /webinar-lp
location /register { try_files $uri $uri/ /webinar-lp; }
```
Will also flag pages that need 301 vs 302.

maya: Good. For SEO we want 301 for canonical consolidation except for temporary A/B tests (302). @jonah please mark which are temporary.

priya: On schema — I'll add Event schema for webinar and FAQ page schema for the benchmark post. Example snippet I'll add to CMS: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Launch webinar: serving at scale","startDate":"2026-06-12T17:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled"}
```
Is that ok?

jonah: Yes. Also add `mainEntity` FAQ objects for key product Qs. That helps rich snippets for the benchmark post.

samir: Quick ask: can we keep the webinar registration page crawlable but exclude thank-you pages via robots? Also ensure thank-you has `noindex, nofollow`.

maya: Agreed. We'll `noindex` the TY page and keep LP crawlable. @launchbot can you trigger the staging crawl after the CMS updates?

launchbot: Deploy pipeline started for branch `marketing/webinar-schema`. Preview URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar-lp-preview — will run lighthouse + staging crawl in ~10m.

jonah: Thx. After staging crawl, I'll run a quick site: search and a link equity check. If any redirect chains >2 hops show up, we'll convert to direct 301s.

priya: One more — internal linking: add two contextual links from the product docs and benchmark post to the webinar LP with `rel=\"canonical\"` pointing back to main landing. I'll add to the content checklist.

maya: Solid. Ownership recap: jonah = canonical/redirect map + schema checklist; priya = CTA copy + content anchors + internal links; samir = UTMs + event tracking; maya = release signoff + CRO experiments. We'll sync tomorrow 10am to review staging crawl results. :calendar: 

jonah: Posted mapping in the ticket: https://linear.app/RW/issue/WEB-412 — includes CSV of old->new URLs.

samir: Added tracking ticket with GA4 events + BigQuery schema: https://linear.app/RW/issue/ANALYTICS-87

priya: I'll drop the final hero copy here once ready. ETA 5pm.

maya: Thanks team — let's avoid any redirect flapping during the first 48h post-launch. :rocket:
